get.description: Апгрейд HTTP→WS для обмена ходами в реальном времени.
Рекурсивно читает все файлы `*.sgf` по указанному пути и сохраняет их в коллекцию `tasks`.

task_level.description:
Difficulty level (chapter index) of the task
required: true
example: 3

task_number.description:
Unique identifier for this task
required: true
example: 42

task_sgf.description:
Raw SGF content of the problem
required: true
example: "(;SZ[19]... )"

task_status.description:
Current status, one of "done" or "not_done"
required: true
example: "not_done"

page_tmp.description:
Current page number (1-based)
required: true
example: 1

page_with_unresolved.description:
First page that still contains not_done tasks
required: true
example: 1

tasks.description:
Tasks on this page
required: true

total_pages.description:
Total number of pages available
required: true
example: 5
